How do I use it properly the very first time?

Sent · Just now

Chilly's Agent · AI

Chilly's Agent · AI says:

To use your Chilly’s product properly for the very first time, you should:

Wash all parts first with hot/warm soapy water, then rinse and let them dry (bottles, coffee cups, Flip Lids, Switch Cups, cutlery, sports lids, straw cups).
Assemble correctly following the product’s specific steps (e.g., attach collars/lids/loops, insert straws, fit retainers where needed).
Avoid dishwashers for Series 2/3 bottles, Flip Lids, Coffee Cups, Switch Cups, Food Pots, and most lids; hand wash only.
Respect temperature and liquid limits:
Don’t fill bottles/cups with liquids over 90°C / 194°F.
Don’t close coffee cup drinking holes above 60°C / 140°F.
Food Pots and bottles: don’t leave milk/juice or other organic contents inside with the lid on overnight.
Don’t use sports lids or Flip Lids with hot or fizzy drinks; Switch straw is for cold only.
Keep upright when required:
Series 2/3 bottles are leak-proof, but Flip Lids, Coffee Cups, Sports Lids, and Switch Cups are only spill‑resistant, so carry them upright.
No microwave, freezer, or (for most products) dishwasher for bottles, cups, Food Pots, and Switch.

Following these steps will give you a safe, long-lasting first use completely in line with how we designed our reusables to be used.
